description: [Migawari] Get the status of a quote or task by id (quote_id q_… or task_id t_…). Brief by default; pass full: true for the complete record. For tasks, the access_token is required. To leave a note for the operator, use send_message.

access_token.description: Required for task ids; the token returned by request_quote.

name: migawari__get_task_status
title: Get task status
